extension.name: TOCus
extension.description: A gentle pause before distracting websites, designed to help you return to your intentions.
extension.descriptionDescription: Short extension description shown by the browser and extension store.

popup.summary: A gentle pause before distracting websites, designed to help you return to your intentions.
popup.foundationNote: This source build includes only the extension foundation. Protection and pause features are still being developed.

languageScreen.title: Language
languageScreen.introduction: Choose the language TOCus uses across the extension.
languageScreen.explicitLanguageDescription: TOCus will keep using this language until you change it.
languageScreen.malformedDataDescription: Your local personalization data is not valid. Restoring defaults will reset appearance, pause, motion, and language preferences.
languageScreen.loadErrorDescription: TOCus could not load your local language setting. Nothing was changed.
languageScreen.restoreDefaultsError: TOCus could not restore your personalization defaults. Nothing was changed.
languageScreen.saveError: Your language could not be saved. TOCus returned to your previous language.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.introduction: Choose the colors and pause style that feel right for you.

breathing.label: Breathing
breathing.description: A soft sphere guides your breathing.

quiet.label: Quiet pause
quiet.description: A still pause with no breathing cue.

appearance.paletteHelp: The selected palette colors the complete pause experience.
appearance.reducedMotionDescription: Keep the pause still and remove movement.
appearance.malformedDataDescription: Your local personalization data is not valid. Restoring defaults will reset appearance, pause, motion, and language preferences.
appearance.loadErrorDescription: TOCus could not load local appearance settings. Nothing was changed.
appearance.restoreDefaultsError: TOCus could not restore your personalization defaults. Nothing was changed.
appearance.saveError: Your appearance could not be saved. Your choice is still shown here.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.introduction: Choose when protection is active. Times use this device’s current time zone.
schedule.alwaysDescription: Keep protection active every day and at every time.
schedule.customDescription: Choose the days and times when protection should be active.
schedule.windowsHelp: An end time earlier than its start continues into the next day.
schedule.equalTimeError: Start and end time must be different.
schedule.dirtyScopeNotice: Save or discard these changes before choosing another scope.
schedule.malformedDataDescription: TOCus found local settings it could not read. They were not replaced.
schedule.loadErrorDescription: Your local settings were not changed. Try loading them again.
schedule.saveError: The schedule could not be saved. Your settings were not changed.
schedule.invalidConfigurationError: The local configuration could not be updated safely.
schedule.invalidScheduleError: Check the schedule and try again.
schedule.scopeNotFoundError: This protection scope is no longer available. Reload the page and try again.

timing.title: Timing
timing.introduction: Set one calm timing pattern for every protected site.
timing.initialWaitHelp: The first interruption of the day starts with this wait.
timing.waitIncreaseHelp: Each completed wait adds this amount to the next wait that day.
timing.maximumWaitHelp: Choose a maximum that is at least as long as the initial wait.
timing.maximumWaitError: Maximum wait must be at least as long as the initial wait.
timing.allowanceHelp: Completing a wait pauses protection for this long.
timing.showContinueDescription: Wait for an explicit choice before opening the site.
timing.openAutomaticallyDescription: Open the requested site as soon as the wait ends.
timing.malformedDataDescription: Your local timing data is not valid, so it was not replaced.
timing.loadErrorDescription: TOCus could not load local timing settings. Nothing was changed.
timing.saveError: Timing settings could not be saved. Your choices are still here.
timing.invalidConfigurationError: Your timing data changed. Retry before saving these choices.
timing.invalidTimingConfigurationError: These timing choices are not valid. Review them before saving.
timing.summaryShowContinue: Waits start at {initialWait}. Each completed wait adds {waitIncrease} to the next wait, up to {maximumWait}. Completing a wait starts an allowance for {allowance} and shows a Continue button.
timing.summaryOpenAutomatically: Waits start at {initialWait}. Each completed wait adds {waitIncrease} to the next wait, up to {maximumWait}. Completing a wait starts an allowance for {allowance} and opens the site automatically.

protectedSiteList.emptyDescription: Add the first site you want TOCus to gently interrupt.
protectedSiteList.sharedGroupDescription: These sites share one wait ladder and allowance.
protectedSiteList.independentGroupDescription: Each of these sites keeps its own wait ladder and allowance.

protectedSites.title: Protected sites
protectedSites.introduction: Choose the websites where a calm pause can help you return to your intentions.
protectedSites.addressHelp: Enter a website address or domain. Whole-domain protection includes its subdomains.
protectedSites.sharedBehaviorDescription: Use the same wait and allowance as your other protected sites.
protectedSites.independentBehaviorDescription: Give this site its own wait and allowance.
protectedSites.invalidSiteError: Enter a valid website address, such as example.com.
protectedSites.alreadyProtectedError: This website is already protected by an existing rule.
protectedSites.invalidConfigurationError: Your protected-site data changed. Retry before adding this site.
protectedSites.invalidScopeError: TOCus could not create independent protection for this site.
protectedSites.invalidDisplayNameError: The website name is not valid.
protectedSites.siteNotFoundError: This protected site no longer exists.
protectedSites.saveError: This website could not be saved. Your entry is still here.
protectedSites.permissionDeniedError: Browser access is required to protect this website. Nothing was saved.
protectedSites.permissionRequestError: Browser access could not be requested. Nothing was saved.
protectedSites.permissionRetainedError: This website could not be saved. Its browser access may still be active.
protectedSites.malformedDataDescription: Your local protected-site data is not valid, so it was not replaced.
protectedSites.loadErrorDescription: TOCus could not load local settings. Nothing was changed.
protectedSites.permissionRetainedAnnouncement: {name} was removed, but its browser access could not be removed automatically.

protectedSiteItem.accessRequestError: Browser access is still required to protect this site.
protectedSiteItem.sharedBehaviorDescription: Uses the shared wait, allowance, and schedule.
protectedSiteItem.independentBehaviorDescription: Uses its own wait, allowance, and schedule.
protectedSiteItem.operationError: Your changes could not be saved. Nothing was replaced.
protectedSiteItem.configurationChangedError: This site changed elsewhere. Reload settings and try again.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.introduction: A private, all-time view of the pauses and choices TOCus has supported on this device.
statistics.estimationDescription: Estimated protected-site time avoided, based on your prior focused use.
statistics.emptyMessage: This is a moment just for you.
statistics.unavailableDescription: TOCus could not read your local statistics. No estimates or totals are shown.
statistics.localDataDescription: Your statistics stay on this device.
statistics.resetConfirmationDescription: Your statistics will start over from zero. Protected sites, schedules, timing, and appearance remain unchanged.
statistics.resetSuccess: Statistics were reset. Your totals now start from zero.
statistics.resetErrorDescription: TOCus could not confirm the reset. No totals are shown until your local statistics can be read again.

interruption.readyAnnouncement: You can continue when you are ready.
interruption.readyExpiredMessage: This visit window has ended. Start another pause when you are ready.
interruption.recoveryFailedAnnouncement: TOCus still could not restore this pause.
interruption.sphereAlternative: A soft clay sphere expands as you breathe in and settles as you breathe out.
interruption.stillSphereAlternative: A soft clay sphere rests at the center of the screen.
interruption.unavailableMessage: TOCus could not restore this pause.

protectedPageLayer.allowanceWarningAnnouncement: Your visit window is ending soon.

allowanceWarning.zero: Your visit window ends in {count} seconds.
allowanceWarning.one: Your visit window ends in {count} second.
allowanceWarning.two: Your visit window ends in {count} seconds.
allowanceWarning.few: Your visit window ends in {count} seconds.
allowanceWarning.many: Your visit window ends in {count} seconds.
allowanceWarning.other: Your visit window ends in {count} seconds.

wellbeing.neutral: This is a moment just for you.
wellbeing.focusedOnly: Since you started, you've taken {focusedPauseTime} for yourself.
wellbeing.estimatedOnly: Since you started, you've given yourself about {estimatedReclaimedTime} back.
wellbeing.both: Since you started, you've given yourself about {estimatedReclaimedTime} back and taken {focusedPauseTime} for yourself.

allowance.lessThanMinuteTitle: Visit window: less than 1 minute remaining
